# kubernetes — 2022 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 21 kubernetes CVEs of 2022 are in `data/cve/vendors/kubernetes/2022.jsonl`.

### CVE-2022-2385 — AccessKeyID validation bypass
- Assigner: kubernetes | Published: 2022-07-12 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: CWE-20 CWE-20 Improper Input Validation
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N`

A security issue was discovered in aws-iam-authenticator where an allow-listed IAM identity may be able to modify their username and escalate privileges.

**workarounds:** Prior to upgrading, this vulnerability can be mitigated by not using the {{AccessKeyID}} template value to construct usernames.

Affected:
- Kubernetes / aws-iam-authenticator: affected v0.5.2 <unspecified (custom); affected unspecified <v0.5.9 (custom)

Credits: Gafnit Amiga

References:
- https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/aws-iam-authenticator/issues/472 [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://groups.google.com/a/kubernetes.io/g/dev/c/EMxHpU-1ZYs [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2022-37968 — Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes cluster Connect Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
- Assigner: microsoft | Published: 2022-10-11 | Updated: 2025-01-02 | Max CVSS: 10
- CWE: Elevation of Privilege
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 10 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H/E:U/RL:O/RC:C`

Microsoft has identified a vulnerability affecting the cluster connect feature of Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes clusters. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated user to elevate their privileges and potentially gain administrative control over the Kubernetes cluster. Additionally, because Azure Stack Edge allows customers to deploy Kubernetes workloads on their devices via Azure Arc, Azure Stack Edge devices are also vulnerable to this vulnerability.

Affected:
- Microsoft / Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes cluster 1.8.11: affected 1.0.0 <1.8.11 (custom)
- Microsoft / Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes cluster 1.7.18: affected 1.0.0 <1.7.18 (custom)
- Microsoft / Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes cluster 1.5.8: affected 1.0.0 <1.5.8 (custom)
- Microsoft / Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes cluster 1.6.19: affected 1.0.0 <1.6.19 (custom)
- Microsoft / Azure Stack Edge: affected 2.2.0 <2.2.2088.5593 (custom)

References:
- https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2022-37968 [vendor-advisory]
- https://portal.msrc.microsoft.com/en-US/security-guidance/advisory/CVE-2022-37968 [x_transferred]

### CVE-2022-45933
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2022-11-27 | Updated: 2025-04-29 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: n/a; CWE-306 CWE-306 Missing Authentication for Critical Function
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

KubeView through 0.1.31 allows attackers to obtain control of a Kubernetes cluster because api/scrape/kube-system does not require authentication, and retrieves certificate files that can be used for authentication as kube-admin. NOTE: the vendor's position is that KubeView was a "fun side project and a learning exercise," and not "very secure."

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

References:
- https://github.com/benc-uk/kubeview/issues/95

### CVE-2022-47633
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2022-12-23 | Updated: 2025-04-15 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: n/a; CWE-287 CWE-287 Improper Authentication
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

An image signature validation bypass vulnerability in Kyverno 1.8.3 and 1.8.4 allows a malicious image registry (or a man-in-the-middle attacker) to inject unsigned arbitrary container images into a protected Kubernetes cluster. This is fixed in 1.8.5. This has been fixed in 1.8.5 and mitigations are available for impacted releases.
